reason: The original screening scope assumed the frozen 16-point maximin seed. An 'earlier active start' strategy (first k points of the same frozen maximin order, then active; identical total label budget; metrics from B16) changes the seed and therefore is a different comparison family. It is kept separate so that neither family can crowd out the other and the protocol-compatible acquisition result is always confirmed on its own.

families.A_post_B16_acquisition: frozen 16-point seed, active from B16 (all week9_phase1_20_acquisition_search policies)

change.finalists: at most 1 per family (so at most 2 in total, as before), each the eligible policy with the largest development paired delta q20 AULC 16-80 vs margin within its family
change.eligibility: unchanged (dev delta 16-40 >= 0; B40 q20 KH recall not below margin by more than 0.03)
change.multiplicity: Holm over the finalists x {16-80, 16-40}, as before
change.family_B_extra_disclosure: family B changes how the first 16 labels are chosen; it is reported as an acquisition-strategy result, never as a like-for-like post-B16 acquisition result
